statutes.title: Revenue Administration and Absence of Individual Income Tax
text_en: Empowers the Department of Revenue to administer tax laws, operating alongside the historic repeal of former AS 43.20 individual income tax by Ch. 1, SLA 1980.
text_es: Faculta al Departamento de Ingresos a reglamentar la administración tributaria estatal, tras la histórica derogación del impuesto individual por el Cap. 1, SLA 1980.
